name: Aphelion of Saturn
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] gem socketing. Instead, you form a rotating [brown]ring of moonlets[/brown] upon entering combat. You have 6 moonlets [effect:hearts][dark-gray]2❤️[/dark-gray][/effect] which block hits from outside of your ring until destroyed. Your ring gains the following stats per socketed gem:

  • [green]Agility[/green]: +25% rotation speed

  • [orange]Favor[/orange]: +5% moonlet [effect:dodge][dark-gray]dodge chance[/dark-gray][/effect]

  • [dark-gray]Haste[/dark-gray]: +0.25❤️ moonlet impact damage

  • [white]Tenacity[/white]: +0.5 blocks moonlet knockback

  • [dark-red]Vigor[/dark-red]: +0.5❤️ per moonlet

[dark-gray]At all costs, forgoing substance for allies.[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Moonlet health scales with how fully socketed your armor is.
Allows moonlets to block attacks without themselves taking damage.
